en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The aim of this course is to gain knowledge of basic technical standards which will be necessary for the students in their further studies as well as principles of engineering drawing, both computer and manual. The students will acquire design skills required for manual and computer processing of technical documentation of landscape engineering and planning.
